title: Second Lessons: Steel
introNarration: Edge's mail shirt clicks once as he leans over and opens the Primer to the Steel page. "You have swung at it. Now cast strike at the dummy in here, and name the stance out loud first, same as before." He straightens up. "Then talk to me. After that the Primer holds one ink that belongs to you. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."
reminderNarration: Cast strike at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Edge. Name the stance out loud first.
completionNarration: Edge picks the Primer up off the anvil and leaves a little linseed on the cover doing it. "You named it before you threw it. That habit will keep you standing." He hands it over. "One ink in there is yours. Open the Primer and type ink and the vein's name."
